title: Phòng trống
about: Round 24, song-tau ("1. Piano + viola: Piano chơi giai điệu thưa; viola kéo những nốt trung trầm, chỉ xuất hiện cuối câu"): G minor in 3/4 at 60 bpm, a sparse tune (a dotted note and a single beat to a bar, the fourth bar held whole), one soft deep note a chord, the violas only where each sentence ends; a middle section in E-flat and B-flat sung twice. An original tune.
